title: NFIR-Compliant Report Variant and 7-Phase Visibility
goal: Add an NFIR report mode that explicitly maps to the 7 mandatory Dutch pentest phases, includes CVSS scores per finding, references the authorization document, and includes a re-audit tracking section.
scope: Add nfir as a framework option in the Compliance Annex report (alongside nis2/soc2/iso27001/pci_dss/dora). The NFIR report contains: (1) 7-PHASE MAPPING: map each finding and task to one of 7 NFIR phases based on tool/profile: httpx/easm/nmap=intelligence-gathering, nuclei/zap=vulnerability-analysis, metasploit/impacket=exploitation, bloodhound/ldap=post-exploitation, all=reporting. Show which phases were executed, which were skipped, and why (out of scope / no findings to escalate). (2) AUTHORIZATION SECTION: show engagement.roe_ref and engagement.authorization_confirmed_at at the top of the report. If missing, show warning: 'Authorization reference not recorded. NFIR requires written authorization before testing begins.' (3) CVSS SCORES: show cvss_score next to each finding (requires backlog-119 to be complete for auto-population; show N/A if not available). (4) RE-AUDIT SECTION: list all open findings with status, age, and retest status. Label verified-resolved findings separately. (5) METHODOLOGY REFERENCES: include PTES, OWASP WSTG, NIST SP 800-115 in the methodology section as NFIR standards. In Mission Control phase diagram, add NFIR phase label tooltip to each phase badge.
generation_reason: NFIR defines the Dutch pentest standard. Clients increasingly require NFIR-aligned reports. Current reports do not map to NFIR 7 phases or include authorization references.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: NFIR report variant only. Do not certify NFIR compliance — only map evidence to phases. Always include disclaimer.

success_criteria: All 7 NFIR phases shown with executed/skipped status.
Authorization section shows roe_ref or warning if missing.
CVSS shown per finding (N/A if not available).
Re-audit section shows open vs resolved findings.

acceptance_criteria: NFIR report renders with 7 phases, authorization section, CVSS, and re-audit section.

after_completion: Promote exactly one next approved task into NEXT_TASK.md.
